executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace with durable Wiki knowledge, diagnostics, explainability, quality scoring, automated review signals, human validation, and governance trust visibility.
executive_summary.milestone_result: Phase 7.6 now exposes governance trust visibility in the user diagnostics UI without altering trust-score calculations, quality-score calculations, or human validation separation.
executive_summary.current_focus_completed: The UI layer now renders governance conflict visibility, review candidate visibility, and governance badges inside page-level Knowledge Quality rows. Frontend typecheck, frontend production build, and backend tests have all passed locally.
executive_summary.next_recommended_focus: Proceed to the next roadmap phase with this handover as the new source of truth.
